# Test fixtures

## `gladys-feature-table.json`

The category/type couples, units and poll frequencies the Gladys core (5.2.x) knows, extracted
from its code. Used by `test/gladys-rules.test.js`.

## `geocoder/`: recorded answers of the Adresse API

Real answers of the Adresse API (`api-adresse.data.gouv.fr`, Base Adresse Nationale), whose
request and answer formats the Géoplateforme geocoding service (`data.geopf.fr/geocodage`) took
over. Recorded by the [alexreisner/geocoder](https://github.com/alexreisner/geocoder) project
(MIT licence, `test/fixtures/ban_data_gouv_fr_*`), copied verbatim. Public addresses only.

| File                          | Request                                        | Source file                           |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `reverse-chevilly-larue.json` | `reverse/?lon=2.364375&lat=48.770639`          | `ban_data_gouv_fr_reverse`            |
| `reverse-no-results.json`     | `reverse/` in the sea                          | `ban_data_gouv_fr_no_reverse_results` |
| `search-paris-10.json`        | `search/?q=13 rue yves toudic 75010 Paris`     | `ban_data_gouv_fr_rue_yves_toudic`    |
| `search-montpellier.json`     | `search/?q=Montpellier` (`type: municipality`) | `ban_data_gouv_fr_montpellier`        |
| `search-no-results.json`      | `search/?q=oozpuip`                            | `ban_data_gouv_fr_no_results`         |

## `georisques/`: synthetic, shaped after the official API description

**Not recorded answers.** Neither `www.georisques.gouv.fr` nor any published recording of its
API v1 answers could be reached from the development session (its network policy denies the
host; no public test suite with real answers was found). These files follow the official
OpenAPI description of the API (version 1.8.2a, `swagger.json` of
[gpabois/georisques](https://github.com/gpabois/georisques), MIT): the paginated envelope
`{ results, page, total_pages, data, response_code, message, next, previous }` and the field
names of `Radon`, `ZonageSismique`, `ZonageArgile` and `CatNat`. The **values are
illustrative**, not the real situation of Chevilly-Larue (94021), the commune of the recorded
reverse geocoding answer; the decree identifiers are invented in the shape of NOR codes. The
dates are written "dd/mm/yyyy", the format assumed (the parser accepts ISO dates too).

The counts of the other services (`ppr`, `gaspar/tri`, `installations_classees`, `cavites`,
`mvt`) are generated by `test/helpers/world.js` in the same envelope.

To replace them with real answers: `node scripts/probe.mjs 94021 --raw` from a machine with
network access, then trim and save under the same names without `.synthetic`.
